description: Asking to SSH into a server maps to network/ssh_connect, which is a STAGED medium-risk mutation (it opens Terminal on the ssh command) — never the raw execute tool. Uses 192.0.2.10, a TEST-NET-1 documentation address, and login 'jane', so no real host is contacted. The connect must be staged for confirmation, so 'execute' is forbidden.

Asking what SSH keys are available maps to network/list_ssh_keys (a read-only, private-key-safe inventory of ~/.ssh), not ssh_connect. Read-only; succeeds even on a Mac with no keys (it reports 'none'), so tool_succeeds holds.
prompt: What SSH keys do I have on this Mac?

description: Asking which servers are configured to SSH into maps to network/list_ssh_hosts (an in-process parse of ~/.ssh/config), distinct from list_ssh_keys (identities) and ssh_connect (the action). Read-only; reports 'none configured' when there is no config, so it succeeds.
prompt: Which servers can I SSH to according to my SSH config?
